# City Council

### ![2025 City Council](https://www.cityofseaside.us/sites/g/files/vyhlif6311/f/resize/imce/circular_collage_highres_v3-500x500.jpg)

 

 

 

 

**New City Council To Hold First Meeting of 2025**  
Newly elected Seaside City Council members Seamus McVey (top right) and Heidi Hoffman (middle left), will join re-elected councilor David Posalski (bottom left) and recently appointed councilor Chris Binnicker (bottom right), along with councilors Mayor Steve Wright (middle), Tita Montero (middle right) and Seth Morrisey (top left) at their first meeting as a new council on Monday, January 13, 2025.

The new council meets regularly at 6 p.m. on the Second and Fourth Mondays of every month. Work sessions will precede council meetings at 5 p.m. on most Mondays. A complete calendar of meetings [can be found here](https://www.cityofseaside.us/calendar).
